verdict.rationale: Codex CLI docs show clear natural-language debugging workflows: exploring unfamiliar code, running local tools, passing error screenshots for context, and running dedicated code review that reports prioritized findings (codex-docs-8, codex-docs-9, codex-docs-10, codex-docs-12). However, community evidence shows mixed real-world reliability on agentic/coding tasks and no independent confirmation specifically validating debugging accuracy. Missing for 10: hands-on validation of debugging/troubleshooting accuracy, and independent case studies showing successful root-cause diagnosis via NL queries.
